summary: Nuburu, Inc. and subsidiary Nuburu Defense entered an Investment Agreement with Tekne S.p.A. and its shareholders to acquire a 70% equity interest in Tekne. Initial 2.9% interest was obtained in January 2026 for a convertible note, with contributions totaling $17,692,000 in convertible receivable. Upon Italian Golden Power approval by September 30, 2026, Nuburu Defense receives 57.1% interest for a $29,692,000 subscription price plus a 10% stock purchase for $5.2M cash and earn-out. Closing within 30 days of approval. Watch regulatory clearance and Tekne performance metrics.
